Samira Khan: Quick one - I was at a vendor co-hosted conference in Lisbon. Hotel bill shows room + VAT + two incidental charges (mini-bar & room service). Vendor paid for two nights and asked Redwood to cover remaining 2 nights; vendor also put one incidental on our folio by mistake. How do we submit?
Evan Ortiz (Events): The vendor agreement said Redwood covers room nights for our reps only, not incidentals. If vendor charged incidentals to our folio accidentally they should re-bill.
Samira Khan: Vendor says they can9t re-issue until next week. Meanwhile I paid the mini-bar and room service on my card because they were needed for an overnight shift. Can I claim those?
Maria (People Ops): Yes, you can claim necessary incidentals you personally paid for. Required: original hotel folio (showing line items), your card statement line, and a short note explaining why vendor couldn't reissue immediately.
Samira Khan: For coding, which expense type? And per-diem for that day? I had a late arrival and left early, so partial day.
Sam Patel (Finance): Use: 
```
Expense type: "Lodging - Incidentals"
Project/Cost center: "Events - Lisbon Summit"
GL account: "6025 - Lodging & Accommodation"
Description: "Incidentals (mini-bar, room service) charged to company folio in error; personal payments attached. Vendor re-bill pending."
Required attachments: hotel_folio.pdf, personal_card_statement.pdf, vendor_note.pdf, manager_approval.pdf
```
Sam Patel (Finance): Per-diem: Redwood pays per-diem for overnight nights only. For partial days, we pro-rate per-diem only when policy allows (e.g., overnight + travel). In your case, if it was an overnight business stay, claim full per-diem for that night; if it was a same-day extended work, no per-diem.
Evan Ortiz (Events): Manager note: I confirm Samira9s stay was business-approved. I'll add a short approval in Expensely.
Samira Khan: One other wrinkle: hotel folio shows VAT on the minibar line that the vendor already reclaimed. Do we reimburse VAT on incidentals?
Sam Patel (Finance): VAT treatment: if vendor is responsible and re-bills us net of VAT, we only reimburse the net. If you paid personally and the receipt shows VAT, upload the original receipt. Finance will attempt reclaim where possible, but usually small incidentals VAT is non-reclaimable; treat as reimbursable.
expense-bot: Reminder: attach PDFs under 10MB. If vendor re-bill arrives later, submit an amendment referencing this claim.
Samira Khan: Thanks all 60a I'll upload folio + card stmt + Evan's approval now.
